<think>
The compilation error arises because cactoos moved LengthOf from org.cactoos.iterable to org.cactoos.scalar and removed the old class. The client code imports the old location and thus fails to resolve LengthOf. The new org.cactoos.scalar.LengthOf provides constructors that accept Iterable, Text, and Input, which matches how it’s used here (with Iterable<Text>). In most recent cactoos versions, this class continues to behave as a Number-like wrapper, so intValue() is still available. Therefore, the minimal and correct fix is to update the import to the new package without changing method calls.
